rice.selection_rationale: Strong balance of low MAE (<Rs.94, <3.7% MAPE) with native state encoding support.

wheat.selection_rationale: Lowest 30-day recursive forecast drift and superior multi-step trend capture.

maize.selection_rationale: Strong balance of low MAE (<Rs.94, <3.7% MAPE) with native state encoding support.

onion.selection_rationale: Non-linear supply/harvest shock resilience. Handles extreme seasonal volatility where linear models fail.

potato.selection_rationale: Non-linear supply/harvest shock resilience. Handles extreme seasonal volatility where linear models fail.
